reviews.title: Great deal especially if you can find on sale
reviews.comment: I've read a lot of reviews about how this CPU is not worth it and under performs compared to comparable AMD CPUs especially for gaming -- and that's very possible if you are an extreme gamer -- but I've had no issues at all and is you can find it if sale like I did then I don't think you can go wrong with it. I've played CoD BO7 and Battlefield 4 and done light graphics and video encoding work with no issues at all.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.title: Fantastic CPU, But Be Mindful of Your Motherboard Choice
reviews.comment:
First off, the whole purchasing experience was great. The seller was thorough and made sure I received the product in a timely manner, which is exactly what you want when you're excited to start a new build. I would definitely purchase this item again based on the processor's performance alone. This Intel Ultra 7 is an absolute powerhouse. It chews through everything from high-end gaming to heavy multitasking without breaking a sweat, and the combination of P-cores and E-cores makes the whole system feel incredibly responsive.
Now, it's important to note that the only flaw I had during my entire build process was not with the chip itself, but with the MSI hardware I paired it with. I ran into some frustrating stability issues and had to wrestle with a few BIOS updates before the system would run smoothly. Once that was sorted out, the processor performed perfectly, but the initial headache was all due to the motherboard. So, while the Intel 265KF gets a full 5 stars from me for being an amazing piece of tech, I'd strongly advise anyone looking to build with it to do some extra research on motherboard compatibility beforehand to save yourself some trouble
